## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents the old 30-second default, so please fix "Update README default timeout to 60 seconds" before merge. The code change and its updated default test are consistent with each other.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update README default timeout to 60 seconds — With this change, a user who omits `--timeout` gets `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." — Users who rely on the README will expect requests to fail at 30 seconds, but they now wait twice as long. — Fix: In `README.md:3`, change "30 seconds" to "60 seconds".
